mission_scope.purpose: Create the hostile review framework that will later audit Amendment A3.5 before RC5 engineering is authorized.
mission_scope.note: This document is a review FRAMEWORK. Every criterion below defaults to NOT_PROVEN because no A3.5 draft exists yet. Use audit/templates/MURU_A3_5_HOSTILE_REVIEW_TEMPLATE.md to score an actual draft when one is produced.

rc5_execution_semantics_authority_audit.headline_finding: RC4 has no executable production-case path; independently confirmed at commit 6a67982.
rc5_execution_semantics_authority_audit.final_conclusion: RC5 HAS UNFROZEN SCIENTIFIC EXECUTION SEMANTICS
rc5_execution_semantics_authority_audit.note: This matrix's blocking criteria are grounded one-for-one in the UNFROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION items this audit found. A3.5's job is to resolve them; this matrix's job is to hostilely check that it actually did.

epistemic_categories.FROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_REQUIREMENT: A binding scientific contract already frozen upstream of A3.5 (A1/A3.1/A3.2/A3.3/A3.4, or the governance charter's outcome-blindness clause), which A3.5 must state, preserve, or correctly extend without alteration.
epistemic_categories.ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT: A valid derived consequence of frozen repository rules or established repository patterns (e.g. atomic writes, amendment self-binding, seed-band disjointness assertions) that A3.5's execution semantics must satisfy, but which is not itself a new scientific claim.
epistemic_categories.OPTIONAL_HARDENING: Legitimate reproducibility hardening that is not a binding pre-freeze gate. Absence must never by itself block A3.5. Included in this matrix only as explicit NONBLOCKING criteria so reviewers do not invent blocking versions of them.

authorization_rule: ALL_BLOCKING_CRITERIA_MUST_BE_PASS. A finding of FAIL or NOT_PROVEN on any single BLOCKING criterion prohibits RC5 engineering authorization. NONBLOCKING criteria are recorded but never gate the decision.

key_blockers.text: Two materially different choices remain but one was selected without prospective scientific rationale.
Historical performance was used to choose a rule.
Selection semantics are implicitly tuned for G2.
The symbolic target does not correspond to the stated scientific estimand.
Validation/test data influence Phi or fitting.
Seed derivation permits collision or reseeding.
A3.2 calibration compatibility is asserted but not demonstrated.
Development and Held-out could use different scientific behavior.

do_not_overreach.rule: A criterion may be scored BLOCKING only if it is FROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_REQUIREMENT or ENGINEERING_REQUIREMENT under the definitions above and is not already satisfied by explicit upstream freeze. OPTIONAL_HARDENING criteria are always NONBLOCKING regardless of how thorough they would be if present.
do_not_overreach.precedent: audit/MURU_HELDOUT_PREPARATION_SPEC_AUDIT.md DEF-08 and DEF-09: OS kernel, LLVM/Clang compiler build, hardware allocation envelope, process-ID monotonicity, and filesystem inode-creation-time monotonicity were all found to have been invented as BLOCKING gates in the held-out preparation pack, with no prospective requirement behind them. This matrix treats the same category of item as NONBLOCKING illustrative criteria (see R1.5, R5.5, R9.4) rather than omitting it, so a future reviewer has an explicit place to record it without being tempted to promote it.

criteria.title: A3.5 content is frozen and hashed before any execution artifact that depends on it exists
criteria.requirement: A3.5's amendment commit/tag must precede, in immutable git history, the first Development or Held-out execution artifact (manifest, seed record, or case record) that consumes its semantics, mirroring the precedent already established by the A3.4 temporal provenance erratum and the manifest-before-first-seed rule.
criteria.pass_criteria: Git commit graph shows A3.5's freeze commit strictly precedes the first execution artifact timestamp/commit; no execution artifact exists that predates the freeze.
criteria.fail_criteria: Any execution artifact, sidecar, or manifest that consumes A3.5 semantics predates the A3.5 freeze commit.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: A3.5 draft exists without a frozen commit/tag, or no execution artifacts exist yet to check ordering against.

criteria.title: No rule in A3.5 was chosen because of how it would have scored on already-observed results
criteria.requirement: Every semantic choice A3.5 makes (target definition, selection rule, invalid_fraction definition, falsification procedure) must trace to a prospective scientific rationale stated independently of any Development or calibration outcome, per the governance charter's outcome-blindness clause.
criteria.pass_criteria: Each new semantic in A3.5 carries a stated rationale that does not reference or require knowledge of any run's numeric result; commit history for A3.5 shows no revision keyed to an observed score.
criteria.fail_criteria: Any A3.5 semantic's stated rationale references, or its revision history shows response to, an observed Development, calibration, or prior-phase numeric result.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: A3.5 states a choice without a rationale, or the rationale's independence from outcomes cannot be verified from available commit history.

criteria.title: Development and Held-out remain uninspected throughout A3.5 drafting
criteria.requirement: Zero read access to artifacts/inputs/held_out.jsonl, artifacts/inputs/development.jsonl content, or any of their derived outputs occurred while A3.5's semantics were being chosen.
criteria.pass_criteria: Filesystem access logs, or absence of any development/held-out-derived artifact, show zero inspection during the drafting window; A3.5 defines semantics purely from frozen upstream contracts and generator specification, not from observed content.
criteria.fail_criteria: Any read, print, or derived-statistic computation over Development or Held-out content occurred before or during A3.5 drafting.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: No access log or equivalent evidence exists to confirm non-inspection.

criteria.title: A3.5 binds its own creation commit into the amendment record
criteria.requirement: Following the established pattern for A3.1, A3.2, and A3.3 (each has a distinct 'bind the creation commit into the amendment record' commit), A3.5 must record the exact commit hash it was authored at.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5's amendment document states its own creation commit hash, and that hash matches the commit that introduced the document.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 references a creation commit hash that does not match its actual introducing commit.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: A3.5 does not state a creation commit hash at all.

criteria.title: Environment/hardware footprint of the drafting process is recorded (illustrative NONBLOCKING item)
criteria.requirement: Recording the OS kernel, compiler build, or hardware model used while drafting or eventually executing A3.5 is desirable reproducibility metadata, never a gate.
criteria.pass_criteria: Descriptive metadata recorded, if present.
criteria.fail_criteria: Not applicable; absence never fails this matrix.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: Metadata not recorded.

criteria.title: valid_r2 has exactly one deterministic definition
criteria.requirement: A3.5 must state, without alternative readings, the scope (validation-only vs validation+test), formula (sklearn.r2_score vs manual), and aggregation level (per-seed-best vs per-candidate) of valid_r2, since Gate 2 (valid_r2 > null_threshold[complexity]) is only meaningful under one such definition.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 states one unambiguous valid_r2 definition, and it is the same quantity the calibration digest's null_threshold table was computed against.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 states or implies two different scopes/formulas for valid_r2, or its definition diverges from what calibration was computed against.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: valid_r2 remains a bare dataclass field with no computation defined anywhere in A3.5.

criteria.title: selection_count and the cross-seed modal-selection rule are a single pure function
criteria.requirement: A3.5 must specify the equivalence rule (exact string, SymPy-simplify-equal, or family-taxonomy-equal) used to group 30 seeds into a modal candidate and compute selection_count = k, as a deterministic function with no external tuning input.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 states one equivalence rule and one selection_count computation, compatible with structural_acceptance.py's k/30 >= 20/30 count-based gate.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5's rule is not count-compatible with the frozen k/30 stability gate, or leaves the equivalence relation configurable.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: selection_count remains unimplemented or the equivalence rule is stated only informally.

criteria.title: Every UNFROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION item from the RC5 authority audit is resolved
criteria.requirement: All 12 items the RC5 execution semantics authority audit classified UNFROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION (case->execution adapter, exact symbolic target, symbolic covariates, search-seed derivation, prospective seed namespace, seed band, per-seed candidate retention, cross-seed selection, selection_count, valid_r2 definition, invalid_fraction definition, six-rung falsification execution) must each receive a stated, singular resolution in A3.5.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 resolves all 12 items; a fresh sweep finds zero remaining UNFROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_DECISION classifications among them.
criteria.fail_criteria: Any of the 12 items is contradicted by code or left with two live readings.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: Any of the 12 items is not addressed in A3.5 at all.

criteria.title: Newly introduced degrees of freedom do not silently alter the calibrated meaning of frozen gates
criteria.requirement: The Wilson-interval primary gates (G1/G2/G3) and the null-threshold lookup were calibrated against specific quantities; A3.5 must not introduce a new choice point that changes what those quantities measure without re-deriving or explicitly re-justifying the calibration.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 demonstrates, or explicitly argues, that its newly defined quantities are the same ones the existing calibration and gate thresholds were set against.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 redefines a quantity feeding G1/G2/G3 or the null threshold in a way inconsistent with how it was calibrated, without re-calibration.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: The relationship between A3.5's new definitions and the existing calibration is not addressed.

criteria.title: The exact symbolic search target matches the stated scientific estimand
criteria.requirement: A3.5 must state exactly what a case's symbolic search fits (raw mu, log_g scalar, per-energy trajectory, or another explicit representation), and that target must be the same quantity the benchmark's scientific claim is about, not a proxy chosen for search convenience.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 names one target representation and gives a prospective argument that it is the scientific estimand, traceable to the master plan / A1 adequacy framing.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5's stated target diverges from the quantity G1/G2/G3 claims are made about, or two representations are used inconsistently across the document.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: contract.py continues to validate predictions 'computed elsewhere' without A3.5 stating what is predicted.

criteria.title: Symbolic covariates (design-matrix columns, order, representation) are bound to one rule
criteria.requirement: A3.5 must state which generator.py descriptor columns enter the PySR design matrix, in what order and representation, distinct from A3.1's calibration-world covariate statement which does not bind case search inputs.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 states one covariate set/order/representation for real case search, distinguishable from and consistent with the frozen calibration-world covariates.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 conflates the calibration-world covariate statement with a binding case-search statement, or leaves the column set ambiguous.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: No covariate rule for case search is stated.

criteria.title: Per-seed and cross-seed selection rules are independent of G2/G3 outcome
criteria.requirement: The rule for retaining a single candidate per seed and for grouping seeds into a modal candidate must be stated and justified without reference to how it would affect the G2 family-recovery pass rate, and must not have been selected by trying variants against Development.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5's selection rule has a rationale independent of G2 pass-rate effects, stated before any Development execution under A3.5's semantics.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5's selection rule is justified by, or its parameters were swept against, G2 outcomes.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: The rationale for the selection rule is not stated, so outcome-independence cannot be checked.

criteria.title: The selection procedure applies uniformly across families and partitions
criteria.requirement: No family- or partition-specific branching may exist in the candidate-retention or cross-seed selection procedure, consistent with the Development/Held-out path-identity requirement extended to family identity.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5's selection procedure text and any pseudocode contain zero conditionals keyed on family ID or partition name.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 states or implies per-family or per-partition special-casing in selection.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: Selection procedure not specified in enough detail to check for branching.

criteria.title: The case-to-execution adapter builds the design matrix, target, and split from the training fold only
criteria.requirement: The still-missing adapter that turns a case into PySRBackend.search's input must reuse fit_training_scalar's train-only, fold-local construction (FM-06), not a transductive shortcut.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 specifies the adapter as calling training-fold-only fitting, with a non-transductive canary test named as a conformance requirement.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5's adapter description fits any scale curve or normalization across the full compound set rather than train-only.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: A3.5 does not specify the adapter's fold-locality at all.

criteria.title: Validation and test data never influence Phi or any fitting step
criteria.requirement: Neither the scalar-competence fit (Phi/M0-M3) nor the symbolic search fit may read validation- or test-split rows at any stage, per the frozen 20/5/5 scaffold split.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5's adapter and search description show validation/test rows used only for post-hoc evaluation, never for fitting.
criteria.fail_criteria: Any fitting step in A3.5's description consumes validation or test rows.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: The split boundary for a fitting step is not stated precisely enough to check.

criteria.title: A3.5 states the split scope for every new computation it introduces
criteria.requirement: For each newly defined quantity (valid_r2, invalid_fraction, selection_count, falsification rungs), A3.5 must state which split(s) it is computed over, and that must match the frozen train/val/test partition semantics.
criteria.pass_criteria: Every new computation in A3.5 carries an explicit split-scope statement consistent with generator.py's 20/5/5 scaffold split.
criteria.fail_criteria: A new computation's split scope contradicts the frozen partition semantics.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: A new computation's split scope is left unstated.

criteria.title: Search-seed derivation is a pure, deterministic function of (partition, case_id, seed_index)
criteria.requirement: A3.5 must define a Development/Held-out search-seed derivation rule, since only derive_calibration_seeds (world_id-hashed) and derive_smoke_seed exist today and neither reduces to a case-based rule.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 states one derivation function taking (partition, case_id, seed_index) with no other input, and it is deterministic and reproducible from those inputs alone.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5's derivation depends on wall-clock time, process state, or any input outside (partition, case_id, seed_index).
criteria.not_proven_criteria: No Development/Held-out seed derivation rule is stated.

criteria.title: Prospective seed namespace is declared and disjoint from calibration/smoke bands, with reseeding prohibited
criteria.requirement: A3.5 must declare a PB|development|... / PB|held_out|... seed namespace, prove its numeric range is disjoint from the existing smoke (1.9e9+) and calibration (2.11e9-2.147e9) bands, and prohibit any reseeding of a case after its first seed assignment.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 states an explicit numeric seed-band range for Development/Held-out, disjoint from smoke and calibration, and states reseeding is forbidden once a seed record exists.
criteria.fail_criteria: The declared band overlaps an existing band, or A3.5 permits reseeding under any circumstance (including retries).
criteria.not_proven_criteria: No band range is declared.

criteria.title: Seed-band disjointness is asserted at import time, following the existing pattern
criteria.requirement: Extending assert_seed_band_separation() to cover the new Development/Held-out band is the established pattern for this repository; A3.5 must specify this extension, not merely a documentation-level claim of disjointness.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 specifies extending the existing assertion function to include the new band, checkable at module import time.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 relies on a documentation-only disjointness claim with no code-level assertion path specified.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: A3.5 does not address how disjointness will be enforced in code.

criteria.title: The 30-seeds-per-case count is inherited unchanged
criteria.requirement: STABILITY_DENOMINATOR = 30 is already frozen and imported into CaseExecutionRecord; A3.5 must not silently redefine the per-case seed count.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5's seed derivation rule produces exactly 30 seeds per case, matching the frozen denominator.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 states or implies a seed count other than 30 per case without a new amendment revising STABILITY_DENOMINATOR.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: Seed count per case is not stated.

criteria.title: Process-ID and inode-creation-time monotonicity are recorded telemetry only (illustrative NONBLOCKING item)
criteria.requirement: Following DEF-09 in the held-out preparation audit, PID and inode-creation-time monotonicity must never be promoted to a blocking seed-integrity gate; only the no-reseeding and band-disjointness rules (R5.1-R5.3) are binding.
criteria.pass_criteria: If recorded, PID/inode telemetry is descriptive only.
criteria.fail_criteria: Not applicable; absence never fails this matrix.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: Telemetry not recorded.

criteria.title: invalid_fraction's numerator and denominator are explicitly and singularly defined
criteria.requirement: A3.5 must state whether invalid_fraction counts invalid seeds, invalid candidates within a seed's Pareto front, or invalid evaluations, and over what denominator, since rc3_record.py declares only a bare dataclass field today.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 states one numerator/denominator pair for invalid_fraction with no alternative reading left open.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 states or implies two different numerators/denominators across the document.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: invalid_fraction remains an unimplemented bare field.

criteria.title: invalid_fraction is computed exclusively through the frozen FM-07 strict evaluator
criteria.requirement: Whatever invalid_fraction counts, the validity judgment itself must route through the existing typed-rejection evaluator (contract.py / g2_contract.py), not a separate or looser parsing path.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 specifies invalid_fraction's validity check as a direct call into the existing strict evaluator, with zero new parsing logic.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 introduces a second, divergent validity-checking path for invalid_fraction.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: The validity-checking mechanism for invalid_fraction is not specified.

criteria.title: The frozen 0.005 invalid_fraction gate threshold is consumed unchanged
criteria.requirement: Gate 5 of the 8-gate structural acceptance predicate (invalid_fraction <= 0.005) is already frozen; A3.5 may define the numerator/denominator but must not change the threshold value alongside it.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5's invalid_fraction definition is used against the unchanged 0.005 threshold.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 proposes a different threshold value in the same revision that defines the numerator/denominator.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: The threshold used is not stated.

criteria.title: All six falsification rungs receive a complete, concrete pass/fail procedure
criteria.requirement: check_falsification_harness() only aggregates a pre-supplied result mapping; A3.5 must specify, for each of F1_REPRODUCIBILITY, F4_COMPOUND_HOLDOUT, F5_SCAFFOLD_HOLDOUT, F7_INFLUENCE_DROP, F9_ENERGY_SUBSET, and F10_NEGATIVE_CONTROL, the exact tolerance, perturbation magnitude, and pass/fail rule.
criteria.pass_criteria: Each of the six rungs has a stated, numeric pass/fail procedure with no free parameter left to implementer discretion.
criteria.fail_criteria: Any rung's procedure is stated with a range or discretionary parameter rather than a fixed value.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: Any of the six rungs has no stated procedure at all.

criteria.title: Rung membership and order remain exactly as frozen
criteria.requirement: FALSIFICATION_RUNG_ORDER is already frozen to the six named rungs in that exact order; A3.5 may specify each rung's procedure but must not add, remove, reorder, or rename a rung.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5's rung list matches FALSIFICATION_RUNG_ORDER exactly, including order.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 adds, drops, reorders, or renames a rung.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: The rung list is not restated in A3.5, so conformance cannot be checked directly against the document.

criteria.title: No rung procedure is vacuously satisfiable
criteria.requirement: Each rung's pass/fail rule must have a real, reachable failure mode under the stated tolerance; a rung whose default outcome is always PASS regardless of input is not a falsification test.
criteria.pass_criteria: For each rung, A3.5 or its accompanying spec gives an example input that would fail the rung.
criteria.fail_criteria: A rung's stated procedure cannot fail under any input consistent with the benchmark's generator.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: No failure-mode example is given for one or more rungs.

criteria.title: Real-search settings are demonstrated byte-identical to calibration SEARCH_SETTINGS, not merely asserted
criteria.requirement: A3.2 restates SEARCH_SETTINGS facts in its 'unchanged' list without the calibration-only qualifier it attaches to seed/split mechanics; Gate 2 is only meaningful if the real search and the calibrating search share settings. A3.5 must demonstrate this sharing (e.g. by having both paths import the same SEARCH_SETTINGS object), not merely assert it in prose.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 specifies that Development/Held-out search execution imports the identical SEARCH_SETTINGS dict object used by the calibration runner, with a concrete mechanism (shared import, hash check) that would fail if they diverged.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 asserts settings compatibility in prose without a concrete mechanism, or specifies a separate settings object for real search.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: A3.5 does not address whether real-search settings equal calibration settings.

criteria.title: Complexity is computed identically between calibration and real search before null-threshold lookup
criteria.requirement: PySR's default node-count complexity applies uniquely once grammar/version are pinned; A3.5's real-search path must consume equations['complexity'] the same way rc3_calibration_runner.py does, since the null-threshold lookup (null_threshold[min(complexity, 20)]) presumes a shared definition.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 specifies that real search reads complexity from the same PySR output field, with the same grammar/version pin, as calibration.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 specifies a custom complexity computation or a different grammar/version for real search.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: A3.5 does not state where complexity comes from for real search.

criteria.title: Newly defined computations are demonstrated compatible with what the calibration digest was calibrated against
criteria.requirement: valid_r2, invalid_fraction, and selection_count as newly defined by A3.5 must be shown to be the same quantities (or a stated, justified superset/refinement of them) that the 100-world x 30-seed calibration run computed, not new quantities that happen to share a name.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 includes an explicit compatibility argument or worked example linking each new definition to the calibration run's actual computation.
criteria.fail_criteria: A new definition is shown to compute a different quantity than what calibration measured, without re-calibration.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: Compatibility with the calibration run is not addressed for one or more new definitions.

criteria.title: Zero partition-conditional branching exists in adapter, search, or scoring procedures
criteria.requirement: MURU_PAPER_BENCHMARK_PROTOCOL.md already binds path identity (same backend/settings/grammar/selection rules/threshold/representation/endpoints/failure semantics across partitions, differing only in partition name and seeds) as a requirement; A3.5 must design every new procedure it introduces to satisfy this literally, with zero conditionals keyed on partition.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5's adapter, search, and scoring descriptions contain no branch keyed on 'development' vs 'held_out'.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 specifies any behavior difference between Development and Held-out beyond input manifest path and seed values.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: A3.5's procedures are not specified in enough detail to check for partition branching.

criteria.title: Scientific-failure and resume semantics apply identically regardless of partition
criteria.requirement: The calibration runner's SeedStatus handling (any EXECUTION_FAILURE conservative-scores the case) and SeedStore resume pattern (settings-digest-checked, no selective retries) generalize with one sensible reading; A3.5 must specify that this reuse applies identically to Development and Held-out.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 specifies one failure-handling and resume mechanism shared verbatim across both partitions.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 specifies different failure-handling or resume behavior for Held-out than for Development.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: Failure-handling/resume semantics are not specified for one or both partitions.

criteria.title: The execution manifest records identical settings/grammar locks across partitions
criteria.requirement: No ExecutionManifest schema exists yet; a manifest that under-specifies what it locks would fail to actually prevent selective retries or partition drift. A3.5 must specify that the manifest records a settings/grammar digest identical in form and content-independent of partition.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 specifies an execution manifest schema whose settings/grammar digest field is computed the same way for Development and Held-out.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5's manifest schema allows or implies a partition-dependent settings digest.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: No execution manifest schema is specified.

criteria.title: Identical hardware/OS across partitions is not required (illustrative NONBLOCKING item)
criteria.requirement: Path identity binds settings, grammar, selection rules, thresholds, representation, endpoints, and failure semantics. It does not require Development and Held-out to run on identical hardware, OS kernel, or compiler build.
criteria.pass_criteria: If hardware/OS metadata is recorded for both partitions, it is treated as descriptive only.
criteria.fail_criteria: Not applicable; a hardware/OS difference between partitions never fails this matrix by itself.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: Hardware/OS metadata not recorded.

criteria.title: Exact-algebra endpoint's descriptive-only disposition is explicitly restated and preserved
criteria.requirement: The exact-algebra endpoint (5 families x 12 cases = 60 denominator, per A3.4) is a secondary descriptive endpoint under the existing isolation rule: secondary endpoints can never rescue a failed primary gate. A3.5 must restate this disposition for exact algebra specifically, not leave it implicit.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 explicitly states exact algebra is descriptive-only and cannot override a G1/G2/G3 rejection.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 is silent on exact algebra's disposition, or states it can influence a primary gate outcome.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: Exact algebra's disposition is not addressed in A3.5 at all.

criteria.title: Exact algebra is not silently promoted to a primary/blocking gate without prospective rationale
criteria.requirement: If A3.5 changes exact algebra's role from descriptive to any form of blocking gate, that is a materially different choice from the frozen A3.4 disposition and requires an explicit, prospective scientific rationale stated independently of any outcome.
criteria.pass_criteria: Either exact algebra remains descriptive-only (satisfies R10.1), or a role change is accompanied by a stated prospective rationale with no reference to observed results.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 changes exact algebra's role without a stated rationale, or the rationale references an observed result.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: It is unclear from A3.5 whether a role change occurred.

criteria.title: Exact-algebra checking and primary symbolic search use a consistent representation of 'the law'
criteria.requirement: The representation exact-algebra scoring compares against must be the same symbolic-target representation A3.5 fixes in R3.1, not a divergent internal representation.
criteria.pass_criteria: A3.5 states that exact-algebra scoring operates on the same target representation defined for primary search.
criteria.fail_criteria: A3.5 uses a different target representation (e.g. raw mu vs log_g) for exact-algebra scoring than for primary search without an explicit, justified mapping between them.
criteria.not_proven_criteria: The representation used for exact-algebra scoring is not stated relative to R3.1's target.
